Full summary: Answered what in .twining/ is tracked vs gitignored for cross-machine git sharing: records/** + config.yml/.gitignore/.gitattributes tracked, db/caches/queues/sentinels ignored, v1 aggregates frozen-until-Node>=22.13. Verified by workflow wf_b75ef3dd-591 (6 refuters + critic; fresh-clone bootstrap EXECUTED). No code or doc changes.
Findings: Fresh-clone bootstrap EXECUTED (wf_b75ef3dd-591, scratch dir, main dist): a .twining/ holding ONLY records/ + config.yml + .gitignore + .gitattributes boots sqlite, creates twining.db, ingests +5464 records in 178 ms with decision/post ids EQUAL to the file set; legacy_unread=false with or without the frozen v1 tier; first embed() downloads the 91 MB model into gitignored models/ and the reconcile of 1444 vectors took ~20 s. Nothing gitignored is needed to bootstrap a second machine.; warning: config keys archive.auto_archive_on_commit and archive.auto_archive_on_context_switch are INERT at HEAD d7860e0 — no reader in src/ or plugin/hooks (only config.ts:47 default + types.ts:309); nothing shipped writes pending-actions.jsonl (pending-processor.ts:95 drains it, only the user-authored post-commit hook in docs/hooks.md:34-45 writes it). The real sqlite archive trigger is the post-time threshold in BlackboardEngine.post (blackboard.ts:181-202: >=500 archivable beyond retain 200) plus twining_archive and housekeeping archive:true. config.yml advertises a behavior that does not exist.; warning: GITIGNORE_ENTRIES (init.ts:20-36) gaps found by the completeness critic: pending-posts.dead.jsonl / pending-actions.dead.jsonl (persistent dead-letter, pending-processor.ts:245-267) unignored; pending-*.jsonl.processing.<pid>.<rand> swap files (pending-processor.ts:207-210, survive a crash mid-drain) unignored; atomicWriteFileSync *.tmp siblings OUTSIDE records/ (blackboard.jsonl, decisions/, graph/, handoffs/, agents/registry.json, embeddings/*.index, config.yml, .gitignore itself — file-store.ts:63-68) unignored while validate-records.ts:195 fails on ANY tracked *.tmp under .twining, so the checker is broader than the ignore rule; pre-reverse-backup/ (reverse.ts:143) unignored so git add -A after migrate --reverse commits the backup; config.yml.pre-migrate.bak is written by config-edit.ts:43-46 on BOTH forward (forward.ts:244) and reverse (reverse.ts:224) and read by nothing.; finding: on the FILES backend agents/registry.json is rewritten on virtually every write tool call — BlackboardEngine.touchAgent (blackboard.ts:80) fires from post (:143), resolve (:300) and decide (decisions.ts:405), writeJSON never short-circuits on unchanged bytes (file-store.ts:112-130) — and the file is tracked-not-ignored on both backends (init.ts:116-119 stub). Liveness thresholds are 5/30 min local signals (liveness.ts:7-10), but twining_register capabilities live in the same file, and plan R-10 rejected aggregates in GITIGNORE_ENTRIES. Recommendation to users sharing a files-backend store: ignore agents/registry.json; on sqlite-era stores it is a frozen aggregate (validate-records.ts:58).; finding: archive locality confirmed — Archiver.archive (archiver.ts:181-195) appends raw entries to gitignored archive/<date>-blackboard.jsonl then dismiss() unlinks records/posts/<ulid>.json (record-export.ts:186-198); the receiving host's ingest deletes the row on absence with no local tombstone. Archived posts and dismissal tombstones (tombstones.ts) never cross hosts via git; only the 'Archive: N entries archived' summary finding propagates. Measured here: commit bc29510 deleted 492 post files in one sweep; last-30-day records churn = 937 A graph / 772 A posts / 161 A decisions / 492 D posts / 157 M graph / 5 M posts / 2 M decisions — entity updated_at rewrites are the same-record conflict magnet (W2 J-6).; finding: the plugin subagent-stop hook queues a 'Subagent completed: workflow-subagent' status post per finished workflow agent; the server drains pending-posts.jsonl into the blackboard and exports each to records/posts/ — 7 such records landed in the committed tree from this session's 7-agent verification workflow. Hook-generated status noise rides git to every host.; finding: ~/code/stillwater/.twining (files backend, dormant since 2026-04-02, no git remote configured) has NO .twining/.gitignore and tracks models/Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2/onnx/model.onnx (90,387,606 bytes), both embeddings/*.index files, and metrics.jsonl; no config.yml or .gitattributes exist there. The #44 boot reconcile would create the gitignore but cannot untrack; fix is git rm --cached models embeddings metrics.jsonl plus a boot.; finding: this repo's validate-records at HEAD d7860e0 reports clean (5459 files, sqlite-era) with the expected informational note that five frozen v1 aggregates are still tracked (blackboard.jsonl, decisions/index.json, graph/entities.json, graph/relations.json, handoffs/index.jsonl); both v1 tiers frozen since the 2026-07-05 migration commit d4cb422. Workflow verifiers left the live tree untouched (checked git status + transcripts: writes only under the session scratchpad, zero twining_* calls).
summary: Answered what in .twining/ is tracked vs gitignored for cross-machine git sharing: records/** + config.yml/.gitignore/.gitattributes tracked, db/caches/queues/sentinels ignored, v1 aggregates froze…
